title: chattocorp/chatto
claim: chattocorp/chatto — A fully-featured team and group chat application that you can easily selfhost.
why_good: The self-hosting capability addresses growing privacy concerns among organizations, making it appealing for businesses wary of data breaches.
value: Companies could pay for premium features, support, and hosting services, creating a subscription model for ongoing revenue.
risk: The market is saturated with established players like Slack and Microsoft Teams, which could easily integrate similar features.
pick_reason: The self-hosted chat application addresses privacy concerns and can be monetized through subscription or support services.
